description: Exceptions for `pnpm data:audit` (docs/data-rules.md). `missing`: Wikidata holders of P35/P6 the data leaves out on purpose, by rule. `verified`: our terms that disagree with Wikidata or that Wikidata lacks, checked by hand against the named source; keyed by Wikidata id, office and our years. `noOfficialName`: states confirmed to have had no official name, so the Persian-name sheet stops asking for one. `persianNames`: Persian names kept although they differ from Wikidata's label or have none there, by Wikidata id, with the reason.
